title: Pending | ASL | 72 Hours
description:
Israel-route flight disrupted. Customer files claim WITHIN 72 hours of arrival. Per business rules, DDS only runs 72 hours post-arrival to allow flight data finalization. Since <72hrs have elapsed, the case is created in PENDING status and queued for automatic DDS assessment once the 72-hour window passes. Different from TC_077 (pre-travel rejection where NO case is created) � here the flight HAS occurred but not enough time has passed for data finalization. The customer gets a case reference and a "welcome back" notification when DDS completes.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger. Journey: Israel route (AC operated). Flight status: Disrupted (flight has occurred). Filing timing: WITHIN 72 hours of arrival (<72hrs elapsed). 72-hour check: FAILS (insufficient time for data finalization). DDS: NOT YET RUN (queued for post-72hr execution). Regime: ASL applicable.
